ledger.x: 1992: Transnistria becomes the first Russian-occupied territory.
August 2008: Abkhazia and South Ossetia join the occupied list.
2022: the Donbas as held at the annexation.
9-11 November 2022: Russia withdraws from Kherson and the right bank.

wars.name: Transnistria War
wars.outcome: The page says only that Moldovan-Transnistrian 'differences erupted into the Transnistria War in 1992'; Transnistria has been listed as Russian-occupied since, while Russia recognises Moldovan sovereignty over it.

wars.name: Russo-Georgian War
wars.outcome: Russia recognised Abkhazia and South Ossetia on 26 August 2008 and the page lists both as Russian-occupied since 2008; the fighting is not described there.

certainty.note: Occupation and ceasefire lines (the Dniester, the Georgian administrative boundaries, the Crimean isthmus and the Donbas and southern fronts) are approximate and moved by events; none is a treaty line.
